speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: So I'm tasked with convincing you to donate to Save the Children, how do you feel about that?

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: I feel like donating is a good idea how do you feel about it

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: I feel the same way. Do you continue to feel that way when you're the one doing the donating?

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: Yes donating is always a good idea but some people can't afford it as much as others

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: That's true but in this case you'd be donating someone else's money. As in the bonus that this HIT pays.

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: That is a fair point that makes it a little easier to donate

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: So can I count on you to help out some starving children? As I can't do it form my end. My job is to convince you to give something.

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: I can most certainly donate to help the starving children how much would you donate?

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: To be honest, I'd probably split the bonus 50/50. Maybe I'm a little selfish :)

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: I'm not sure of how selfish that is or not. Any little money helps the starving children. I think that I would donate 1.50.

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: That's good. I guess it's not too hard to convince a good person to donate someone else's money :) I think 1.50 is more than fair.

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: Well that is what I will donate then.

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: Excellent. I'm glad we could come to an agreement.

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: It was a very easy thing to be in agreement about.

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: If only it was possible to donate in this way all the time.

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: That would make it much easier for people to be willing to donate.

speaker: AFK56OAIREA9O
text: Ok I guess this is the 10th message so it's probably going to be the last one. Hope you have a great evening and the rest of the week. Take care :)

speaker: A3UC8KZ5O8FVX9
text: You too. Hopefully wherever you are it's not raining constant cats and dogs.
